chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Is'haq ibn Ammar who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) judged regarding the man who was struck upon his lower area, so he could no longer withhold his faeces nor his urine - regarding that is the complete wergild'.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal ruling for an injury that causes loss of bowel and bladder control?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), clarifies that a strike to the 'ijan' (lower abdomen/groin) causing incontinence of both stool and urine constitutes a major injury warranting full wergild (diya kamila). It reflects the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the functional loss of bodily control as a significant disability, linking the physical harm directly to the comprehensive compensation established by Imam Ali (AS).
